tasks.brief:
Implementation constraints: ES5 JavaScript (var, function expressions), runs in browser. Create src/static/catalog.js (new file, under 150 lines). No async/await — use Promise.all and .then/.catch. Expose window.Catalog = { fetchModels, refreshModels }. Reference window.App.pollStatus and window.App.appendBubble lazily (only inside functions that need them). Do NOT reference window.Chrome.

Behavioral specification:
1) Declare var previousModelValue = null; at module top.
2) fetchModels(): fetch BOTH /api/v1/models and /api/v1/models/catalog in parallel (Promise.all). Merge: options = lmstudio entries from /api/v1/models plus ALL catalog entries. Label: (loaded ? '🟢 ' : '○ ') + id; prefix '✓ ' when id === modelSelect.value. Set data-loaded='true'/'false'. If catalog fetch fails, fall back to lmstudio only.
3) populateModelOptions(models): clear modelSelect, preserve previous selection. Install 'Select model...' placeholder when nothing matches. Install change handler: on focus/mousedown capture current value into previousModelValue. On change: if data-loaded='false', show load-confirm-modal with text. load-cancel restores selection. load-confirm POSTs /api/v1/script-models/{id}/load, polls status, refreshes models. Overlapping-load guard: if TC.modelLoading is true, revert selection without opening modal.
4) refreshModels(): call fetchModels then populateModelOptions.
5) Expose window.Catalog = { fetchModels, refreshModels }.

Acceptance: grep -q 'window.Catalog' src/static/catalog.js && grep -q 'fetchModels' src/static/catalog.js && grep -q 'refreshModels' src/static/catalog.js && grep -q 'previousModelValue' src/static/catalog.js

Implementation constraints: ES5 JavaScript (var, function expressions), runs in browser. Modify src/static/threads.js. The coder receives the full existing file and emits anchored SEARCH/REPLACE blocks only — do NOT restate carried-forward behavior.

Behavioral specification: Add the following changes to src/static/threads.js:
1) In renderSidebar(): after building sidebar rows, call CurrentChat.refresh() to sync the header title.
2) In switchThread(threadId): before switching, call CurrentChat.commitPending() so a mid-edit thread switch commits first (AC-118).
3) In deleteThread(threadId): when deleting the current thread, fall back to the NEWEST remaining thread (last element of threads[]), not the first.
4) In updateTitle(threadId, title) and maybeRetitle(threadId, content): store full-length titles (cap 120 chars, no baked '...' — AC-127).
5) In renderThreadMessages(thread): when building each restored assistant bubble's copy source (dataset.raw), normalize citations and strip  tags to match the live-stream path (AC-128).
6) In createThread(): prefer a LOADED model over the dropdown's sticky value; leave the model empty (placeholder) when nothing is loaded.

Acceptance: grep -q 'addSources' src/static/threads.js && grep -q 'msg-sources' src/static/threads.js
